name: Bishop Mara
source:
She is the head of the Church of [url=/c171800]Luminox[/url]. Not much is known about her past. A victim of the war in Ryosei, she came to the Church for shelter, ultimately becoming a priestess and rising through the ranks thanks to her generosity and compassion. She has a soft spot for [url=/c166919]Ravena[/url].
